title: WPSS/1143/2004 of KAILASH CHANDRA KAPIL and ORS. Vs STATE and ORS.

paras.text:
COURT NO.2
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) 1143/2004
Kailash Chandra & Others
ÖÖ.Petitioners
Versus
State of Uttaranchal
through Forest Secretary
And Others.
 ÖÖ.Respondents
Sri Rakesh Thapliyal, learned Counsel for the petitioners.
Sri H.M. Raturi, learned Standing Counsel for the respondents.
22nd August, 2008
Honíble P.C. Verma, J.
Petitioners claim out of turn promotion on the post
of Forester as several similarly situated employees,
namely, Ramcharan Baroni, Jayanand Nautiyal and
Gautam Prasad Bhatt have been given out of turn
promotion on account of their merit.
2. Relevant facts of the case are that each of the
petitioners were initially appointed as Forest Guard.
Forest Guards are required to undergo the ëForest Guard
Trainingí and after completing the said training,
concerned incumbents are being awarded the grade
according to their performance in the training. After
undergoing the said training, petitioners were awarded
first place and declared as toppers in the training. Since
1973, the promotions were made to the post of Forester
out of turn from amongst those Forest Guards who stood
topper in the Forest Guard Training. Some employees
who were similarly situated to the petitioners were given

2
out of turn promotions after taking into consideration
that they stood topper in the said training.

3. Principal Chief Conservator of Forest from time to
time also recommended that promotions to the post of
Forester may be made from amongst those Forest Guards
who obtained first place in the Forest Guard Training.
Similar provision is also provided in respect of the
Foresters.
4. Since several similarly situated candidates who
stood topper in the Forest Guard Training, on the basis
of which they were given out of turn promotion to the
post of Forester and this has been the criterion to give
out of turn promotion, therefore, respondents are
directed to consider and promote the petitioners also on
the same line on which these persons as mentioned
above have been promoted. Writ petition is allowed
accordingly but with no order as to costs.
